key.name: show-indicator
key.summary: Show Global Menu
key.description: Master toggle for the whole global menu bar.

key.name: menu-app-enabled
key.summary: Show App menu

key.name: menu-file-enabled
key.summary: Show File menu

key.name: menu-edit-enabled
key.summary: Show Edit menu

key.name: menu-view-enabled
key.summary: Show View menu

key.name: menu-go-enabled
key.summary: Show Go menu

key.name: menu-window-enabled
key.summary: Show Window menu

key.name: menu-help-enabled
key.summary: Show Help menu

key.name: custom-menus
key.summary: JSON list of custom menu sections
key.description: Each entry: {label, enabled, items: [{label, kind: "command"|"shortcut", value}]}. Supports any number of independent custom top-level menus.

key.name: displaced-keybindings
key.summary: Keybindings displaced while a shortcut set is enabled
key.description: JSON object mapping "schemaId:key" to the displaced GVariant, serialized so switching a set off can restore the user's own binding even after the preferences window has been closed and reopened.

key.name: displaced-settings
key.summary: Desktop settings displaced while an Appearance or Windows switch is on
key.description: JSON object mapping "schemaId:key" to the GVariant the key held before, serialized so switching the look off can give back the user's own fonts, accent and window behaviour even after the preferences window has been closed and reopened. null means the key was at its default and goes back to it.

key.name: show-logo-menu
key.summary: Show the System Menu button

key.name: logo-icon-name
key.summary: System icon name for the System Menu button

key.name: logo-custom-icon-path
key.summary: Path to a custom icon file for the System Menu button
key.description: Highest priority: when non-empty, overrides everything else.

key.name: logo-distro-icon
key.summary: Bundled distro icon stem (e.g. "pear", "fedora", "arch"), empty for none

key.name: logo-distro-icon-symbolic
key.summary: Use the symbolic (single-color) variant of the bundled distro icon

key.name: logo-icon-size
key.summary: Icon size in pixels for the System Menu button

key.name: system-menu-font-size
key.summary: Type size of the System Menu, in pixels
key.description: The pear menu only. File, Edit and the rest of the bar have their own size. 13 is GNOME's own menu size.

key.name: menu-bar-font-size
key.summary: Type size of File, Edit and the other bar menus, in pixels
key.description: The titles in the bar, and the menus they open. The pear menu has its own size. 13 is GNOME's own.

key.name: menu-bar-padding
key.summary: Horizontal padding of each File/Edit title, in pixels
key.description: Room on each side of a title. Zero packs them against each other.

key.name: hide-overview-button
key.summary: Hide the Activities/overview button

key.name: clock-on-the-right
key.summary: Move the clock to the far right of the panel
key.description: GNOME centres the clock; macOS keeps it in the corner with the status icons to its left.

key.name: hide-power-button
key.summary: Hide the Quick Settings power icon
key.description: The top bar shows a power glyph only on a machine without a battery. With one, the same place shows the battery, which stays.

key.name: hide-panel-spacers
key.summary: Hide inactive GNOME status placeholders
key.description: Screen recording, screen sharing, dwell click, accessibility and keyboard layout indicators.

key.name: group-spotlight-with-quick-settings
key.summary: Keep the Search Light icon next to Quick Settings

key.name: gap-before-quick-settings
key.summary: Space to the left of the Quick Settings icons, in pixels
key.description: Separates them from whatever sits before them, such as a search icon.

key.name: gap-before-clock
key.summary: Space between the Quick Settings icons and the clock, in pixels

key.name: status-icon-padding
key.summary: Padding on each side of a status area item, in pixels
key.description: Lower values pack the icons and clock more tightly. Zero leaves no space at all between them.

key.name: notifications-top-right
key.summary: Show notification banners in the top right corner
key.description: Under the clock, as on macOS. GNOME puts them under the clock too, centred while it is in the middle; this keeps them on the right wherever the clock is, and whatever another extension sets.

key.name: banners-slide-from-right
key.summary: Slide notification banners in from the right edge
key.description: As on macOS: a banner comes in from beyond the right edge of the screen and goes back out there when its time is up or it is dismissed, instead of dropping from the top. Only while notifications are in the top right corner. Follows the shell's animation settings.

key.name: osd-top-right
key.summary: Show the volume and brightness bubble in the top right corner
key.description: Under the bar, as on macOS, instead of at the bottom centre of the screen.

key.name: hide-workspace-popup
key.summary: Show no popup when switching desktops
key.description: GNOME shows the desktops for a moment whenever a shortcut switches to another one or moves a window there. macOS only slides the desktop across, which the shell still does.

key.name: spaces-spring
key.summary: Switch desktops on a spring, with a rubber band at the ends
key.description: As Spaces move on macOS: a keyboard switch, and the slide after a three- or four-finger swipe, land softly in about 0.4 seconds; pulled past the first or last desktop they stretch and spring back, and the switch shortcut there gives a small bump. With dynamic workspaces the last desktop is the empty one GNOME keeps.

key.name: always-show-workspace-thumbnails
key.summary: Always show the desktops along the top of the overview
key.description: GNOME hides them until two are in use; Mission Control shows its Spaces however many there are.

key.name: start-on-desktop
key.summary: Start on the desktop, not in the overview
key.description: GNOME opens the overview at login; macOS shows the desktop. Takes effect at the next login.

key.name: smooth-auto-brightness
key.summary: Fade automatic brightness changes instead of jumping
key.description: With Automatic Screen Brightness on, the screen moves to each new light level over a few seconds, brightening faster than it darkens, as on macOS. The brightness slider and keys still act at once, and so does dimming when idle.

key.name: screenshot-thumbnail
key.summary: Show a floating thumbnail after a screenshot
key.description: The picture shrinks into the bottom right corner, beside the dock, and stays there for five seconds, longer while the pointer rests on it. Clicking it opens the file; dragging or swiping it to the right puts it away.

key.name: screenshot-thumbnail-hide-banner
key.summary: Hide GNOME's Screenshot captured banner while the thumbnail shows
key.description: The notification stays in the list until the thumbnail goes. GNOME 46 and later; GNOME 45 always shows the banner.

key.name: macos-window-animations
key.summary: Open and close windows as macOS does
key.description: A new window fades in while growing slightly from its centre, and a closing one fades while shrinking slightly, instead of GNOME's pop up from the bottom edge. Dialogs attached to their window keep GNOME's unfold.

key.name: steam-buttons-left
key.summary: Put Steam's window buttons where GNOME's layout has them
key.description: Steam ignores GNOME's button layout. This patches its client stylesheets (keeping the originals) so close, minimize and maximize follow it, from the next start of Steam.

key.name: show-search-icon
key.summary: Show a search icon on the right of the bar
key.description: Sits where macOS keeps Spotlight, to the left of the status icons.

key.name: search-opens
key.summary: What the search icon opens
key.description: GNOME's own search, the Search Light extension, or a command of your own. Falls back to GNOME's search whenever the choice is unavailable.

key.name: search-command
key.summary: Command the search icon runs when set to a custom command

key.name: show-system-settings
key.summary: Show System Settings item in System Menu

key.name: show-app-grid
key.summary: Show App Grid item in System Menu

key.name: show-software-center
key.summary: Show Software Center item

key.name: software-center-command
key.summary: Command for Software Center

key.name: show-system-monitor
key.summary: Show System Monitor item

key.name: system-monitor-command
key.summary: Command for System Monitor

key.name: show-terminal
key.summary: Show Terminal item

key.name: terminal-command
key.summary: Command for Terminal

key.name: show-extensions-app
key.summary: Show Extensions item

key.name: extensions-app-id
key.summary: Desktop file ID of the extensions manager app to launch
key.description: e.g. "org.gnome.Extensions.desktop" or "com.mattjakeman.ExtensionManager.desktop"

key.name: show-force-quit
key.summary: Show Force Quit App item

key.name: show-power-options
key.summary: Show Sleep/Restart/Shut Down items

key.name: show-lock-screen
key.summary: Show Lock Screen item

key.name: show-log-out
key.summary: Show Log Out item

key.name: show-recent-items
key.summary: Show the Recent Items submenu

key.name: recent-items-limit
key.summary: How many entries each Recent Items section lists
key.description: Applications, Documents and Servers are each limited to this many, as in macOS.

key.name: system-menu-custom-items
key.summary: JSON list of custom shell-command items added to the System Menu
key.description: Each entry: {label, value}. Appears as its own section at the bottom of the System Menu.

key.name: desktop-app-name
key.summary: Name for the file manager in File → New … Window
key.description: Used in the File menu's "New X Window" item while a file manager is in front. Empty, the default, uses the name the system gives the application, such as "Files".

key.name: dock-magnification
key.summary: Magnify dock icons under the pointer
key.description: Dash to Dock icons near the pointer grow and push their neighbours apart, as on macOS. Pear Up draws this over Dash to Dock at runtime; none of Dash to Dock's own settings change.

key.name: dock-magnification-size
key.summary: How large the icon under the pointer grows, in percent of its normal size
key.description: 110 is a hint of movement, 300 triples the icon. Neighbours grow less the further they are from the pointer.

key.name: dock-bounce-on-launch
key.summary: Bounce an app's dock icon while it starts
key.description: The Dash to Dock icon of an app being launched hops away from the screen edge until its first window appears, as on macOS, for at most ten seconds. Pear Up draws this over Dash to Dock at runtime; none of Dash to Dock's own settings change.

key.name: dock-bounce-on-attention
key.summary: Bounce an app's dock icon when it asks for attention
key.description: When a window of an app that is not in front asks for attention, its Dash to Dock icon hops three times, as on macOS, and stops as soon as the app is brought forward.

key.name: dock-focus-highlight
key.summary: Keep Dash to Dock's backdrop behind the focused app
key.description: Dash to Dock draws a grey backdrop behind the icon of the app in front. When this is off, Pear Up's stylesheet removes it; none of Dash to Dock's own settings change.

key.name: quit-app
key.summary: Shortcut that quits the focused app
key.description: Every window of the app, the way Cmd+Q works on macOS. GNOME's own close binding only takes one window. The macOS Window Shortcuts switch puts Super+Q here.

key.name: debug-logging
key.summary: Enable verbose error logging to the system journal
key.description: Off by default to avoid excessive logging; turn on temporarily when diagnosing an issue.
